hero.eyebrow: Tires & auto repair on York Street
hero.title: Tires and repairs *you can count on*
hero.lede: New and used tires, wheels, brakes and oil changes in Aiken for more than 20 years, plus Penske truck rentals. Tire repairs with no appointment, and 90-day financing with no credit check.

image.alt: A close-up of a car’s alloy wheel and tire on a sunny street

items.title: New tires
items.text: Top-performing tires from major brands, priced through several wholesalers so you get the right set at the best price.

items.title: Used tires
items.text: A huge selection from 12″ to 20″, and larger sizes when we have them. Call to check your size.

items.title: Large & agricultural
items.text: Low-profile and mud tires on wheels up to 32″, plus tractor-trailer, agricultural and lawn and garden tires.

items.title: Brakes & oil changes
items.text: Brake repair, rotor and caliper replacement and oil changes at fair prices.

items.title: Wheels & lift kits
items.text: Aftermarket wheels from Wheel Pros and ATD, and lift and leveling kits.

items.title: Detailing supplies
items.text: Carolina Shine detailing products in our lobby: cleaners, degreasers, soaps and odor eliminators.

items.title: Find the puncture
items.text: We locate exactly where the air is getting out.

items.title: Prep the tire
items.text: The damaged spot is cleaned and prepared for the repair.

items.title: Plug and patch
items.text: A plug or patch goes into the puncture.

items.title: Seal it
items.text: The patch is sealed with a tar-like adhesive, so you drive away safely.

sections.title: Moving? *Rent the truck here*

image.alt: A yellow Penske rental truck on a city street

body: We’re a Penske Truck Rental location. Rates are low and the trucks are new and well maintained, with the service you expect from Penske. Reserve moving equipment with your truck, even a way to tow your car, and it will be ready when you pick up.
Penske also offers damage waivers and insurance for your truck and your belongings.
list: Free unlimited miles on one-way moves
More than 2,400 locations to drop off

items.q: Do I need an appointment for a tire repair?
items.a: No. Come by during business hours and we’ll take care of it.

items.q: Do you have used tires in my size?
items.a: We stock a huge selection from 12″ to 20″, and larger sizes when available. Call (803) 648-4040 to check.
Yes: a 90-day payment option with no credit check.

items.q: Can you handle big or farm tires?
items.a: Yes. We mount and balance low-profile and mud tires on wheels up to 32″, and tractor-trailer, agricultural and lawn and garden tires.

sections.title: Flat tire? Come on by.
sections.text: Walk-in tire repairs on York Street, Monday to Saturday.
